risk_notes.risk: Factory primer may have degraded from weather exposure during construction
risk_notes.mitigation: Scuff sand all factory primer. Apply bonding primer if adhesion test fails.

risk_notes.risk: Overworking modified urethane products causes roping/brush marks
risk_notes.mitigation: Apply, tip once, walk away. Do not go back and rework. Sand and recoat if defects remain.

risk_notes.risk: Excess material in frame corners during brush application
risk_notes.mitigation: Load brush lightly, work coating out of corner onto flat surfaces.

material_notes.selection_guidance: Material system selection follows Fine Finish Doctrine: QT3 = SYS_FF_STANDARD_ACRYLIC, QT4 = SYS_FF_MODIFIED_URETHANE, QT5 = SYS_FF_PREMIUM. Door frames and door slabs use the same systems.
material_notes.coverage_variability: Frames have less surface area than door slabs. Coverage is per-SF applied. EA (frame set) is the production unit, not the coverage unit.
material_notes.open_time_by_chemistry: Oil-based has longest working time. Standard waterborne enamel has moderate open time. Modified urethane/waterborne urethane (Advance, Emerald Urethane) has SHORT open time (5-10 min).
material_notes.environmental_requirements: Per product PDS. Generally 50-90°F, <85% humidity, adequate ventilation.

assumptions.value: Frame sets consume ~60% of door slab consumable rate
assumptions.note: No doctrine defines frame vs slab consumable ratios. Derived from surface area estimation.
